subject: Temple of Fiends
text: The party must have the LUTE from the Princess from the beginning of the game to proceed in the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote:
Make sure you have the 
LUTE from the Princess from the beginning of the game.

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: A Katana can be found in the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote:
Also, 
you will find another Procape, and another Katana in case you have more than one 
Ninja (as if you could make it this far with 2 Thieves...).

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: A Procape can be found in the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote:
Also, 
you will find another Procape, and another Katana in case you have more than one 
Ninja (as if you could make it this far with 2 Thieves...).

subject: Frost D
text: Frost Ds appear in packs of 4 and can freeze as many as 800 HP from the party in a single round.

evidence.quote:
You will find Frost D's in packs of 4, who can 
freeze as many as 800HP out of you in a single round.

subject: Gas D
text: Gas Ds appear in packs of 4 whose poison can deal up to 1200 damage to the entire party per round.

evidence.quote:
Gas D's will be back in 
full forced packs of 4 as well, whose Poison can cause 1200 damage Max on the 
whole party per round.

subject: Solo player
text: Solo players can survive unrunnable encounters by repeatedly using Defense or the White Shirt until enemies stop hitting, then restoring HP with the Heal Staff.

evidence.quote:
For solo players, the only way I found to survive was 
to use Defense/White Shirt repeatedly, no matter how hard they hit.  Eventually, 
they stopped hitting me, and I could kill them off, and restore some HP with my 
Heal Staff.

subject: Orb
text: Stepping through the passage revealed by pressing A at the Orb leaves no way out except resetting, dying, or casting EXIT or WARP several times.

evidence.quote:
Go up to the Orb and Hit A to reveal a 
passage.  Note that when you step through here, the only way out is to reset, 
die, cast EXIT, or cast WARP several times.

subject: Phantom
text: Phantom is undead, making FIR3 or HRM3 and HRM4 effective against him.

evidence.quote:
If 
you're too insecure to fight, he's undead, so FIR3 or HRM3,4 will do nicely.

subject: Phantom
text: Defeating Phantom rewards 1 EXP and 1 GP.

evidence.quote:
You 
will be rewarded a generous 1 EXP and GP for your efforts.

subject: stone plate
text: Opening the stone plate at the top of the room requires using the LUTE.

evidence.quote:
You will find another stone plate at the top of the room, much like 
the one in the Earth Cave, only you will have to use the LUTE to open it.

subject: Lich
text: The revisited Lich has 500 HP.

evidence.quote:
[BOSS FIGHT]-Lich revisited
HP-500

subject: Lich
text: The revisited Lich possesses NUKE, which can cause over 300 damage per character.

evidence.quote:
This Lich has NUKE, which can 
easily cause over 300 damage per character.

subject: Lich
text: Defeating the revisited Lich rewards 500 EXP and 1 GP.

evidence.quote: You will be skimpily rewarded with 500 EXP and a GP.

subject: Kary
text: The revisited Kary has 700 HP.

evidence.quote:
[BOSS FIGHT]- Kary revisited
HP- 700

subject: Kary
text: Casting AFIR provides sufficient defense against Kary's FIR3 and HOLD spells.

evidence.quote:
She will only cast FIR3 and 
HOLD (I think), so AFIR should be sufficient for defense.

subject: Kraken
text: The revisited Kraken has 900 HP.

evidence.quote:
[BOSS FIGHT]- Kraken revisited
HP-900

subject: Kraken
text: Mages should defend with the White Shirt or cast INV2 or FOG2 against Kraken, or attack with NUKE or LIT3.

evidence.quote:
Red Mages and White Mages 
should use the White Shirt or cast INV2 or FOG2.

Otherwise, you 
can cast NUKE if you have the Magic Points to spare, or cast LIT3 instead.

subject: Masmune
text: The Masmune is found on the Air floor and has 56 Damage and 50 Hit%.

evidence.quote:
In case you haven't figured this out by now, you will find the Air floor 
next.  You should go all the way down and right to get the Masmune, the best 
sword in the game by a huge margin.  It has 56 Damage and 50 Hit%.

subject: Tiamat
text: The revisited Tiamat has 1100 HP.

evidence.quote:
[BOSS FIGHT]- Tiamat revisited
HP-1100

subject: Tiamat
text: Level 40 or higher Masters can defeat the revisited Tiamat in one hit.

evidence.quote:
Well, Level 40+ Masters can take him out in one hit, but 
let's not assume you have one.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos has 2000 HP.

evidence.quote:
[BOSS FIGHT]   ---CHAOS---
HP-2000

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos casts CUR4 approximately every 7 to 8 rounds to fully restore all HP.

evidence.quote:
Chaos's worst attack is CUR4.  He will 
use it about every 7-8 rounds, and he'll get all his HP back.

subject: Chaos
text: Against Chaos, power up with FAST, Power Gauntlet, SABR, TMPR, INVS, and FOG before unleashing an all-out attack as soon as he casts CUR4.

evidence.quote:
Instead, POWER UP.  
FAST all your Knights/Ninjas/Masters/Red Wizards.  
Use the Power Gauntlet if you have it.  Cast SABR, TMPR, INVS, FOG.

Then, as soon as he casts CUR4, start your 
attack.  Go all out.
